generic_sampling_rules.integer_pk: Sequential integers starting at 1; unique; never NULL; generated PKs disjoint from compact PKs.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_fk: Copy an existing parent key; never NULL for NOT NULL FK columns; never emit a value outside the parent key set; include parent rows without children by omitting child rows, not by NULLing the FK.
generic_sampling_rules.integer_quantity: Positive integers; include boundary values at listed literals and one step on each side.
generic_sampling_rules.real_amount: Non-negative real numbers with one decimal; include boundary values at listed literals and one step on each side.
generic_sampling_rules.text_short: Short human-readable strings; include near-variants of listed equality/LIKE literals (case and one-character changes).
generic_sampling_rules.text_enum: Values drawn from the listed enum set; include near-variants of listed literals.
generic_sampling_rules.text_numeric: Numeric strings with one decimal place; include boundary values at listed literals and one step on each side.
generic_sampling_rules.null_share: Only genuinely nullable columns receive NULL; each such column gets at least one NULL row per instance; NOT NULL and primary-key columns never get NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.distinct_duplicates: On DISTINCT-target columns, allow 20-50% duplicate values; never apply to primary-key or UNIQUE columns.
generic_sampling_rules.order_ties: On ORDER/LIMIT-target columns, plant ties at the listed rank; never apply to primary-key or UNIQUE columns.
generic_sampling_rules.group_sizes: On GROUP-target columns, produce groups of size 1, 2 and >= 3; never apply to primary-key or UNIQUE columns.
generic_sampling_rules.planting_order: Apply all planting helpers after dedupe and FK repair; re-run PK/UNIQUE dedupe after planting.
